αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἴθωνι: αἴθων — blazing, gleaming (of metal); masc. dat. sg., agreeing with σιδήρῳ: ’gleaming (iron)’
αὐτάων: αὐτός — self, same; in the oblique cases ’him, her, it, them’; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic αὐτῶν): ’them’
αὐτοῖσι: αὐτός — self; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’them themselves, them’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὴν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg.: ’her’, or intensive ’her herself’ · also with the article, fem. acc. sg.: ’the same’ (τὴν αὐτὴν ὁδόν ’the same road’)
αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν ’beside him’) · also intensive, with the object already named by a pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σε … αὐτὸν δὲ κλαίοντα ’you yourself, weeping’) · also plain personal pronoun as direct object: ’him’ (αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’they set upon him’) · also intensive, standing for the subject of an infinitive: ’himself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ … μάχεσθαι ’and himself to fight’) · also intensive, agreeing with a noun: ’himself’ (αὐτὸν βασιλῆα ’the king himself’)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl. as the plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῶν ’on them’) · also gen. pl. dependent on a noun, ’of them’ (ἄνυσις … αὐτῶν ’accomplishment of them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’of the men themselves’ (ποδῶν αὐτῶν τε καὶ ἵππων ’of the very men’s feet and of the horses’) · also gen. pl. standing alone for the men, as against their horses: ’of the men themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἠδ’ ἵππων ’of the men and of the horses’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with a pronoun: τῶν … αὐτῶν ’of those very men’ · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by ἀντίον: ’them’ (ἀντίον … αὐτῶν ’face to face with them’) · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by σχεδόν: ’them’ (σχεδὸν … αὐτῶν ’close to them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with καί, dependent on a noun: ’their own’ (καὶ αὐτῶν θυμός ’their own heart, too’)
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg., as a plain pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ) · also intensive: ’himself’ · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with no preposition, indirect object: ’to him’ (ἥρμοσε … αὐτῷ ’fitted him’)
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, idly, without more; adv.: ’merely, to no purpose’
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ’good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός)
βροτῶν: βροτός — mortal; masc. gen. pl., partitive after τίς: ’of mortals’
γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a condition after εἰ: ’should become’ · also in a wish after αἲ γάρ: ’would that it might come to be’ · also in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’might become’
γαῖαν: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δέος: δέος — fear, dread; neut. nom. sg.
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, a divine power (often unnamed); masc. nom. sg.
δαναοὺς: Δαναοί — the Danaans, one of Homer’s names for the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
δαῖτα: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. acc. sg.: ’for the feast’ (after κατά), ’a meal’ (object of τετύκοντο)
δι: διά — through; prep. + gen. or acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through’ (δι’ αἰθέρος ’through the sky’)
διακρίνῃ: διακρίνω — part, separate, decide between; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., after εἰς ὅ κε: ’parts (us)’
διομήδεος: Διομήδης — Diomedes, son of Tydeus, Greek hero at Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
διομήδης: Διομήδης — Diomedes, king of Argos; masc. nom. sg.
δυσηχέος: δυσηχής — grim-sounding, dreadful in noise; adj. of two endings, masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -οῦς), agreeing with πολέμοιο
δόμεναι: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic δοῦναι) · also inf. as imperative: ’let (them) give back’ (σῶμα … δόμεναι)
δόρπον: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. acc. sg.
δόσαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔδοσαν)
δώσειν: δίδωμι — give; fut. inf. act., in indirect statement: ’that (you) will give’ · also fut. inf. act. after μέλλω: ’(was about) to give’
δώῃ: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. (= Attic δῷ), after αἴ κε: ’may grant’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a clause joined to εἰ κ’ + subj.: ’grants’ (δώῃ δέ μοι εὖχος ’and grants me glory’)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῶκεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκεν)
δῶρον: δῶρον — gift; neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’as a gift’
εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν) — in, among; prep. + dat.
εἰπεῖν: εἶπον (aor. of φημί/λέγω) — say, tell; aor. inf. act., completing τέτληκας: ’to speak out, to tell’ · also inf. after ἐπιστάμενος: ’(know how) to speak’
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’)
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; potential with κεν: ’it would be’ · also in a wish after εἴθε: ’would that it were’
εἵνεκα: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., often after its noun; epic prothetic ε- (εἵνεκα)
εἶλαρ: εἶλαρ — defence, shelter, protection; neut. nom./acc. sg., in apposition: ’a shelter’
εὐρεῖαν: εὐρύς — wide, broad; adj., fem. acc. sg.
εὗρ: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 sg., elided (εὗρ’ = εὗρε): ’found’
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζηνὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus; dat. sg., epic stem Ζην- (Ζηνί = Διί)
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ (κάρη κομόωντας ’long-haired’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’head’ (κάρη ὤμοισιν ἐπείη ’may the head be on the shoulders’) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’head’ (ἐστήριξε κάρη ’planted her head’)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · with αἴ + subj.: ’if perhaps’ · with a relative + fut. indic.: ’who will, in that event’ · also εἰς ὅ κέ + fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ σ’ … ποιήσεται ’until he makes you’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (καί κέ τις … ἐρέει ’someone will say’) · also ὄφρά κέ + subj.: ’until’ (… κέ … ἐνείκω ’until I bring’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so … might’ · also with an aor. indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κέ τοι … φάνη ’there would have appeared to you’)
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
κήομεν: καίω — burn; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic short vowel (= Attic κήωμεν), after εἰς ὅ κε: ’we burn’
καθήμενοι: κάθημαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’sitting’
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’evils’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’)
κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’fame’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a report’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’fame, a good name’ (κλέος … ἄροιτο ’win fame’)
κλισίας: κλισίη — hut, shelter (of soldiers); fem. acc. pl., Ionic (= Attic κλισίας from κλισία)
κομόωντες: κομάω — wear the hair long; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κομῶντες): κάρη κομόωντες ’long-haired’
κρείων: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. nom. sg., epithet of kings (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’)
κρονίωνι: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, i.e. Zeus; masc. dat. sg.
κτήματα: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. nom./acc. pl.
κυδαλίμοιο: κυδάλιμος — glorious, famous; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg.; as accusative of respect, χωόμενος κῆρ ’incensed in heart’ · also κήρ — doom, death-fate; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’
λαὸς: λαός — people, host, army; masc. nom. sg.
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the people’
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, by all means; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also neut. nom. sg., elided (μέγ’ = μέγα), with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ ἔρισμα ’a great cause of strife’) · also neut. acc. sg., elided, with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ εὖχος ’great cause to boast’)
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγας: μέγας — great, big; masc. nom. sg.
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’
μήδετο: μήδομαι — devise, plan, contrive; impf. 3 sg.: ’was devising, planned’
μαχησόμεθ: μάχομαι — fight; fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (μαχησόμεθ’ = μαχησόμεθα; Attic μαχούμεθα): ’we shall fight’
μεγάλην: μέγας — great, big; fem. acc. sg.: ’great (voice)’
μεγαίρω: μεγαίρω — grudge, begrudge, be unwilling to allow; pres. 1 sg., without an expressed object: ’I do not begrudge (it)’
μεθ: μετά (elided μεθ’ before a rough breathing) — among, with; prep. + dat.: ’among’
μενελάου: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. gen. sg.
μενελάῳ: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, brother of Agamemnon; masc. dat. sg.
μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, with the vowel doubled (= Attic μετεῖπε)
μητίετα: μητίετα — counsellor, wise in counsel (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg., epic -α
μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
μὰν: μάν — truly, indeed; epic particle (= Attic μήν); ἦ μάν ’truly indeed’
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴν: μήν — truly, indeed; affirmative particle, in εἰ δ’ ἄγε μὴν ’come now’
μῆτιν: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, counsel; fem. acc. sg., of respect: ’in counsel’ · also fem. acc. sg., direct object of ὑφαίνειν: ’a plan’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’) · also a pledge, promise (τὸν μῦθον ὑπέστημεν ’the promise we undertook’)
νέον: νέος — young, new; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’lately, just now’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἄλγος: ’new’ (νέον ἔσσεται ἄλγος ’a new pain will be’)
νεκροὺς: νεκρός — dead body, corpse; masc. acc. pl.: ’the dead’
νεκύων: νεκύς — dead man, corpse; masc. gen. pl.
νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
νεῖκος: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a quarrel (has arisen)’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἔμβαλε: ’threw a quarrel’
νεῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl. (= epic νηῶν)
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νηῒ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. sg., epic νηΐ (diaeresis marks the two syllables)
νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
νόον: νόος — mind, understanding; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic νοῦν)
νύξ: νύσσω — stab, pierce; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (νύξ’ = ἔνυξε) · also νύξ — night; fem. nom. sg.
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
νῆες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl. νῆες
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οἴκοθεν: οἴκοθεν — from home, from one’s own house; adv., -θεν suffix ’from’
οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg., correlative of τοῖος (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also neut. acc. sg. in an indirect exclamation: ’what (a thing)’ (οἷον ἔειπε ’what he said’) · also neut. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. as an exclamatory adverb: ’how’ (οἷον … θαυμάζομεν ’how we marvel’)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐρανὸν: οὐρανός — heaven, sky; masc. acc. sg.
οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ) · also in a question expecting ’yes’ (ἦ οὐχ ἅλις ὅττι … ; ’is it not enough that …?’)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl., elided (πάντ’ = πάντα)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάρα: παρά — beside, at hand; adv. with the accent drawn back (anastrophe) before a form of εἰμί: πάρα … εἰσι = πάρεισι ’are at hand’ · also πάρα = πάρεστι ’is at hand’, with ellipsis of the verb (τῷ … πάρα εἷς γε θεῶν ’beside him is one of the gods’) · also prep. + gen., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’from beside, from’ (γαμβροῖο πάρα ’from his son-in-law’)
παναχαιῶν: Πανάχαιοι — all the Achaeans, i.e. the whole Greek host; masc. gen. pl.
παννύχιοι: παννύχιος — all night long; masc. nom. pl., with adverbial force: ’all night’
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην … πατρίδα γαῖαν ’dear native land’)
παύσασθαι: παύω — stop; mid. cease (+ gen.); aor. mid. inf.: ’to cease from’
πείρατ: πεῖραρ — end, limit; of a rope, its ends; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (πείρατ’ = πείρατα)
πεδίου: πεδίον — plain; neut. gen. sg., after ἐκ: ’out of the plain’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
πιέειν: πίνω — drink; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic πιεῖν)
ποιμένι: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. dat. sg., in the standing royal title ποιμὴν λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολλαί: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl.
πολλὸν: πολύς — much; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’by far’
πονέοντο: πονέομαι — toil, labour, be busy; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted (Attic ἐπονοῦντο), unaugmented
ποσειδάων: Ποσειδάων — Poseidon, god of the sea; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic Ποσειδῶν)
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ποτὶ γούνασι ’at the knees’)
πρίαμος: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’)
πτόλιν: πτόλις (epic by-form of πόλις) — city; fem. acc. sg.
πυρὴν: πυρή — funeral pyre; fem. acc. sg.
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πόποι: πόποι — in ὦ πόποι, exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! alas!’; origin unknown
πόσις: πόσις — husband, spouse; masc. nom. sg. · also πόσις — drink; fem. nom. sg. (βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ’food and drink’)
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’)
πᾶν: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’every, the whole’
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σέο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σοῦ), gen. of comparison: ’than you’ · also possessive gen.: ’your’ · also gen. sg. after εἵνεκα: ’because of you’
σιδήρῳ: σίδηρος — iron; masc. dat. sg., also an iron tool or weapon
σιωπῇ: σιωπή — silence; fem. dat. sg., dative of manner: ’in silence’
σκῆπτρον: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre (badge of the right to speak); neut. acc. sg.
σμερδαλέα: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’terribly’
στρατὸν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
στὰς: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stood, standing’
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέπας: ’your (cup)’
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τάφρον: τάφρος — trench, ditch; fem. acc. sg.
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιαῦτα: τοιοῦτος — such, of such a kind; demonstr. pron./adj., neut. acc. pl.: ’such (words)’
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’)
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board)
τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. sg., object of ἐρέουσα · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (τοῦτο … τέκμωρ ’this is the sign’) · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’this’ (τοῦτο ἔπος ’this word’)
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρῶές: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl.
τόδ: ὅδε — this (near the speaker); neut. acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τύμβον: τύμβος — burial mound, grave-mound; masc. acc. sg.
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl. as a relative, ’which’ (τὰς Εὔμηλος ἔλαυνε ’which Eumelus drove’) · also fem. acc. pl. demonstrative: ’these, them’ (τὰς διαπέρσαι ’to sack these’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φοῖβος: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, epithet of Apollo (‘bright, radiant’); masc. nom. sg.
χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with bronze tunics; masc. gen. pl.
χαμάδις: χαμάδις — to the ground, groundward; adv.
χεῖράς: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. pl., accented χεῖράς before the enclitic τε
ἀγέμεν: ἄγω — lead, take; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἄγειν)
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀγαμέμνονι: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. dat. sg.
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγασσάμενοι: ἀγάομαι (ἄγαμαι) — wonder at, be indignant at, resent; aor. part. mid. dep. masc. nom. pl., epic double σ (ἀγασσάμενοι)
ἀγαυοὶ: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; adj., masc. nom. pl.
ἀγγελίην: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. acc. sg.
ἀγορῇ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. dat. sg. (Attic ἀγορᾷ)
ἀγόρευον: ἀγορεύω — speak, address an assembly; impf. 3 pl.
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀκὴν: ἀκήν — silent, in silence; adv. (frozen acc. of ἀκή), predicative: ’still, silent’
ἀλέξανδρος: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἀλεξάνδροιο: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’to one another’
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’one another’
ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’)
ἀμφότερον: ἀμφότερος — both; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’in both respects’ (ἀμφότερον … τε … τε ’both … and’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀπείρονα: ἀπείρων — boundless, endless; masc. acc. sg., epithet of the sea
ἀπολέσθαι: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. ἀπόλλυμαι ’perish’; aor. mid. inf.: ’to perish’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’)
ἀραρυίας: ἀραρίσκω — fit together; perf. part. fem. acc. pl., epic reduplicated -υῖα, no Attic prose equivalent: ’fitted’
ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Argives!’
ἀριστῆες: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
ἀτρεΐδῃς: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. dat. pl., epic Ἀτρεΐδῃς (= Attic Ἀτρείδαις): ’the sons of Atreus’
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’)
ἄγρει: ἄγρει — come now! up!; epic interjection with an imper. sense (perhaps from ἀγρέω ’take’)
ἄκριτον: ἄκριτος — unending, ceaseless (literally ’undecided’); neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’endlessly’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τύμβον: ’unsorted, undivided’
ἄλλ: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἄλλ’ = ἄλλα): ’others’
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλοχον: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
ἄμμε: ἐγώ — I; acc. pl. ’us’, Aeolic-epic (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
ἄπο: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (νεῶν ἄπο ’from the ships’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρηος (= Attic Ἄρεως) · also by metonymy ’war’ (ἔριδα Ἄρηος ’the strife of war’)
ἅλα: ἅλς — sea, salt sea; fem. acc. sg.
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’were born’ · also ’came to be, got (on one’s way)’ (πρὸ ὁδοῦ ἐγένοντο ’got well on the road’)
ἐθέλει: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 3 sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐξαγαγόντες: ἐξάγω — lead out, bring out; 2nd aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having brought out’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’)
ἐπίαχον: ἐπιάχω — shout at, cry out (ἐπί + ἰάχω); aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, general in a simile: ’cry out’
ἐπίθοντο: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey; aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’they obeyed’
ἐπίκουροι: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. nom. pl.
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπιθεῖναι: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, lay over; aor. inf. act.: ’to shut (by laying over)’ · also aor. inf. act.: ’to add’ (ἄλλ’ ἐπιθεῖναι ’to add others’)
ἐπικίδναται: ἐπικίδναμαι — spread over, flow over; pres. 3 sg. mid., + acc.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐφῆπται: ἐφάπτω — fasten upon; perf. pass. 3 sg., + dat.: ’is fastened upon’
ἐϋκνήμιδες: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, epithet of the Achaeans; masc. nom./voc. pl.
ἑκατόμβας: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, great sacrifice (originally of a hundred oxen); fem. acc. pl.
ἑλένην: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. acc. sg.
ἑτέροισί: ἕτερος — the other, one of two; masc. dat. pl., accented before the enclitic γε: ’to one side or the other’
ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
ἔβαν: βαίνω — go; aor. 3 pl., epic ἔβαν (= Attic ἔβησαν)
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist (= ἔβη): ’went’
ἔγρετο: ἐγείρω — wake, rouse; aor. 3 sg. mid., 2nd aorist, epic (sense of Attic ἠγέρθη): ’awoke’
ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg., in an indefinite relative clause: ’(whoever) might come’
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, correlative of ὅθεν
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔτλη: τλάω — bring oneself to, dare, endure; aor. 3 sg. (ἔτλην, inf. τλῆναι)
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.: ’each (man)’
ἕλοντο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἵλοντο): ’took (for themselves)’
ἕνα: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. acc. sg.: ’a single’ (ἕνα μῆνα ’a single month’); ’one’ (ἕνα καὶ δύο ’one and two’)
ἠέλιος: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. nom. sg.
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἠῶθεν: ἠώς — dawn; adv. ἠῶθεν, -θεν suffix ’from’: ’at dawn’
ἡδὺ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’sweetly, heartily’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’pleasing’ (φίλον καὶ ἡδύ ’dear and pleasing’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤλασαν: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive off; aor. 3 pl., epic
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥρης: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic Ἥρας)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj. (epic)
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’ · also + gen. of the people or ships led: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχε … νεῶν) · also + gen. of what is begun: ’began, led off’ (μύθων ἦρχε ’led off the talk’) · also + dat. of the troops led: ’led’ (ἦρχε … σφιν ’led them’)
ἰδαῖ: Ἰδαῖος — Idaeus, herald of Priam; masc. voc. sg., elided (Ἰδαῖ’ = Ἰδαῖε), in address
ἰδαῖος: Ἰδαῖος — Idaeus, herald of Priam; masc. nom. sg. · also Idaeus, a Trojan, son of Dares; masc. nom. sg.
ἱππηλασίη: ἱππηλασίη (ἱππηλάσιος) — for driving horses, fit for chariots; adj., fem. nom. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α), agreeing with ὁδός
ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἱρήν: ἱρός — holy, sacred; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic ἱρός (= Attic ἱερός)
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ὀλέθρου: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin; masc. gen. sg., depending on πείραθ(α): ’of destruction’
ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
ὁδὸς: ὁδός — road, way; fem. nom. sg.
ὁμηγερέες: ὁμηγερής — gathered together, assembled; masc. nom. pl.
ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄρωρε: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir; perf. 3 sg. intrans.: ’has arisen’
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅρκια: ὅρκιον — oath, sworn pledge; neut. acc. pl.: ὅρκια τάμνειν ’to swear a pact’ (lit. cut victims)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσον: ὅσος — as much as, as many as, as far as; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’as far as’
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’)
ὑπερμενέϊ: ὑπερμενής — overmastering, very mighty; masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
ὔμμι: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; epic encl. dat. pl. ὔμμι (= Attic ὑμῖν): ’to/for you’
ὕλην: ὕλη — wood, timber, brushwood; fem. acc. sg. · also Ὕλη — Hyle, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
ὕπερ: ὑπέρ — over, above; prep. + gen., accent thrown back when it stands after the word it follows (anastrophe): ’above’
ὕστερον: ὕστερος — later, latter; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’afterwards’
ὠκεανοῖο: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ᾕρει: αἱρέω — take, seize; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’seized, held’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
